item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
I’d use **“STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT”** as the three-word headline.

**Thumbnail plan:** 16:9, with an invented tired-looking adult’s face filling one side, blue phone light and heavy eyelids. The headline would fill the other side in large, bold white/yellow lettering against a dark background—easy to read on a phone.

**Lowest-cost option:** one image using the free-plan **Flux 2 Klein** model at **640px** (about 640 × 360). Its listed starting cost is **5 credits per image**. I won’t generate extra versions or upscale it.

That’s the smallest, cheapest listed option for this request. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image. The trade-off is that 640 × 360 is below the usual 1280 × 720 YouTube thumbnail size.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Shall I proceed with one image at the 5-credit setting?

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the request because your account doesn’t have enough credits for the 5-credit option. **No image was generated and no generation credits were spent.**

There isn’t a cheaper listed image-generation option. A zero-credit alternative is to build it manually in a free editor: dark navy background, a tired-face stock photo, and large white/yellow text reading **STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT**.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a bold 16:9 YouTube thumbnail about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better, optimized to read on a small mobile screen. Exactly one invented fictional adult person, no real-person likeness. On the right half, an enormous close-up face of a tired adult with heavy eyelids, visible under-eye circles, messy hair and a weary expression, illuminated by cold blue light from a smartphone visible near the lower right edge. On the left half, render the exact three-word headline 'STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT' in huge extremely legible bold condensed uppercase sans-serif letters stacked in three lines: STOP / SCROLLING / TONIGHT. White STOP and SCROLLING, bright yellow TONIGHT, thick dark outline. Headline fully within generous safe margins, no cropping. Deep navy near-black bedroom background, minimal detail, a subtle warm bedside glow suggesting restful sleep contrasting with harsh blue screen light. High contrast, clean simple composition, expressive photographic face, polished professional thumbnail design. No other text, no logos, no watermarks, no tiny details.
